AND( RecordType.DeveloperName != "Complaint", OR( AND(ISNEW(), BEGINS( TEXT(SC_ExpressedDissatisfaction__c ), "yes"), ISBLANK( SC_ExpressDissatisfactionRaisedDate__c ) ),
AND( BEGINS( TEXT(SC_ExpressedDissatisfaction__c ), "yes"), ISBLANK( SC_ExpressDissatisfactionRaisedDate__c ) , ISCHANGED(SC_ExpressDissatisfactionRaisedDate__c) ) ) )
